behaviors.description: Change only the selected installation's current branch among competing copies.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent test/master commits installed in disposable default, named and user stores.
behaviors.expected: Changing each selected store to test changes only its branchless launch commit; all competitors retain master and explicit restoration selects master again.

mappings.rationale: Real branchless sandbox launches expose exact independent current commits in public sandbox metadata for every competing store.

surface_assertions.rationale: Only user launches switch current branch; default/named launches remain unchanged.
Only default-system launches switch current branch.
Only named-installation launches switch current branch.
